title: Git dependency that follows a branch name
description: package.json declares a git dependency whose fragment names a branch instead of a commit. The branch moves, so every install can compile a different tree while the manifest and the review record stay identical.
remediation: Pin the fragment to a commit sha and update it deliberately.
limitation: It matches a git dependency whose fragment names a branch instead of a commit in the parsed package.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
